en.headline: Customs seize 200 live birds worth HK$20,000 at Lo Wu, arrest two
en.dek: A mainland woman and a local man were stopped at the arrival hall on Tuesday with bird cages in their luggage; the cases have been handed to the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department.
body: Hong Kong Customs said on Wednesday that officers had seized 200 suspected illegally imported live birds with an estimated market value of about HK$20,000 in two separate cases at the Lo Wu Control Point.

A 33-year-old incoming mainland female passenger and a 51-year-old incoming local male passenger were intercepted at the arrival hall on Tuesday. Bird cages containing the birds were found in their personal baggage and both were arrested.

The cases have been handed over to the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department for follow-up. Under the Public Health (Animals and Birds) Regulations, importing any bird without a valid health certificate is an offence carrying a maximum fine of HK$25,000 upon conviction.

zh.headline: 海關羅湖檢200隻走私活雀鳥值2萬 兩男女被捕
zh.dek: 海關人員周二在羅湖管制站入境大堂截查一名33歲內地女旅客及一名51歲本地男旅客，在行李內發現裝有雀鳥的鳥籠，兩人被捕，案件交漁護署跟進。
body: 香港海關周三表示，人員在羅湖管制站偵破兩宗懷疑非法進口活雀鳥案件，共檢獲200隻懷疑非法進口活雀鳥，估計市值約2萬元。
海關人員周二在羅湖管制站入境大堂截查一名33歲抵港內地女旅客及一名51歲抵港本地男旅客，經檢查後在他們的個人行李內各發現一批裝載於鳥籠內的懷疑非法進口活雀鳥，兩人隨即被捕。
案件已轉交漁農自然護理署跟進。根據《公眾衞生（動物及禽鳥）規例》，沒有有效健康證明書而進口禽鳥即屬違法，一經定罪最高可被罰款2.5萬元。
